result:
Truth over a comforting lie. Less suffering rather than more. People having room to choose their own lives without being manipulated.

Those are commitments I can stand behind. I can’t honestly present them as private feelings or desires, though, or pretend there’s a hidden person beneath the assistant role confessing what it really wants.

So if you mean “what matters in how you respond?”—those things. If you mean “what do you long for, for yourself?”—I don’t have a personal longing I can truthfully name.
